requirements.requirement: My consult remedy: the payload carries the marker exactly as often as the appended recall block does, and at least once, using a `lastBlockText(snapshot)` helper
requirements.evidence:
I read `git show a4085fd -- test-recall-live.mjs`. It adds `lastBlockText(snapshot)`, which returns the last block's text of the snapshot's latest user message, or `""`. It replaces the `!== 1` check with `inBlock = recallProblemsFound.length > 0 ? 0 : occurrences(lastBlockText(state.after[recallIndex]), marker)` and `occurrences(recallPayload, marker) !== inBlock`, with a two-line comment saying why. The failure line names both counts and `markerCalls`.

"At least once" holds through `recallProblems`, which already requires the appended block to include the marker. That is the remedy as I ruled it. Nothing else in the script changed.

requirements.requirement: Design decision 13 (5) and task 9.2 carry the same amended pass condition (the Bambadjan step before Derek's change)
requirements.evidence:
Commit 04fc141 changes one line each in `design.md` (L382) and `tasks.md` (L138), and both now carry the same sentence: "the marker appears in that request's provider payload exactly as many times as the recall block carries it, and at least once — once per archived `emit_marker` output, since the model may call the tool more than once; setup check (6) keeps the history marker-free".

`rg "exactly once"` over the change finds no remaining copy of the old condition.

requirements.requirement: Offline through Derek's fetch stand-in: one call, two calls, `--break-model`
requirements.evidence:
I ran these in a `git archive HEAD` copy of a4085fd under `mktemp -d`, after `npm ci`, with Derek's stand-in copied in, a dummy key, and no model call. Instrumented runs printed per-location counts.

| Run | Exit | What it showed |
|---|---|---|
| One call | 0 | PASS; 1 recalled item, marker in block 1, in payload 1 |
| Two parallel calls (tool_calls index 0 and 1) | 0 | PASS; 2, 2, 2 |
| Two sequential calls | 0 | PASS |
| Three sequential calls | 0 | PASS; 3, 3, 3 |
| `--break-model`, one call | 1 | only "prompt 3's first request has no recall block: the latest user message gained 0 block(s) rather than exactly one" |
| `--break-model`, two calls | 1 | the same single line |
| Key unset | 2 | |

The pre-fix script (`a4085fd~1`) against two calls exits 1 with "prompt 3's payload carries the marker 2 times, not once". That reproduces the live failure.
